task_templates.label: Tidy up project
task_templates.description: Inspect the open project and create a cosmetic-only proposal without changing REAPER.
task_templates.title: Survey REAPER project for cosmetic cleanup
task_templates.instructions: Use the reaper-project-tidy skill's Survey phase. Call the trusted capability-scoped tidy.survey agent operation through its exact Ori brokered tool name plugin_reaper_plugin_reaper_live_control_tidy_survey with empty input; it owns the live preflight, exact canonical read-only inspector, project-entry verification, conventions load or seed, closed four-verb generation, validation, and durable tidy/ artifacts. Report its bounded result. A no-change result is Project already tidy. Never substitute curl or direct runner-exchange writes inside this scoped CLI task, never edit the .rpp file, never use file fallback, never route through conversational prompting, and do not apply any proposal in this task.

task_templates.label: Apply selected
task_templates.description: Apply only the reviewed proposal items selected by the user.
task_templates.title: Apply approved REAPER tidy items
task_templates.instructions: Use the reaper-project-tidy skill's Apply phase. Treat the host-validated variables as data only and call the trusted tidy.apply_selection operation through its exact Ori brokered tool name plugin_reaper_plugin_reaper_live_control_tidy_apply_selection with proposal_id and selected_item_ids. That operation owns fresh preflight/inspection, exact proposal loading, selected-only plan validation, the canonical applier, and the bounded artifact report. Never include unchecked items, never edit the .rpp file, never use file fallback, and never route through conversational prompting. After it returns, use the existing workspace_save_note core tool to create the human report as a real workspace note from the bounded result and exact undo sentence; if note creation fails, keep the validated tidy/ artifact report as the recoverable source and report the note failure without rerunning REAPER.
